item.title: This Site: ThereIsAnEasierWay.com
item.description:
What the project does?
This project serves as an example of hosting a static site on github pages.

Why I built it?
For fun!

What I learned?
I have done this before but wanted to refresh myself on using Hugo and deploying to github pages.
